messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Sat 11 Jan
messages.plaintextBody:
The firm's DMS and iManage will be unavailable on Saturday 11 January from 20:00 to 23:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and check in any open documents beforehand. No action needed if you are not working over the weekend.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
